title: Clearer feedback at the front desk
summary: Hosts see progress during booking actions and can keep reading the dashboard as it refreshes. Host Studio also supports early checkout.

title: Natura media moves to Firebase Storage
summary: The Natura design pages keep their original links while photos and other media load from Firebase Storage.

title: Aroha branding in Host Studio
summary: Host Studio shows the Aroha Retreat logo and keeps legal links visible at the bottom of the workspace.

title: A dashboard for the day’s work
summary: Studio opens on arrivals, departures and booking requests. Hosts can find guest profiles and review payments, invoices and sent emails. Guests can download issued invoices and receipts.

title: Saved IDs for future check-ins
summary: Guests can keep a newly saved ID photo for use on later visits.

title: Private identity review and guest numbers
summary: Guests can manage private ID photos, and booking managers can review them from active bookings. The release adds guest numbering and improves booking details on smaller screens.

title: A lighter website download
summary: Public retreat media moved to Firebase Storage, reducing the size of the files shipped with the website.

title: Explore the Living Map
summary: The Living Map introduced an illustrated farm route with eleven places to explore and a Reading View.

title: Core library updates
summary: Compatible updates to Firebase, Resend and OpenTelemetry are available on the test site.

title: Review early checkout
summary: Hosts can review an early departure before confirming checkout. The booking records the actual checkout time.

title: Clearer checkout timing
summary: The booking drawer shows when checkout opens and explains why the action is unavailable before that time.
